subject: FY2015 End of Year Budget Transfers
overview: The Council approved over $1 million in fiscal year 2015 budget transfers to address deficits in snow removal and public safety overtime. The body also established new requirements for school maintenance budgeting and restricted operating hours for a new victualler license.

items.title: FY2015 End-of-Year Budget Transfers
items.summary: Approved $1,088,200 in budget transfers to cover deficits in police overtime and snow and ice removal, following a failed amendment to divert $75,000 from the transfer to immediate road repairs.

items.title: Tasty Gourmet Common Victualler License
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Antonio J. Pereira at 321B Boston Avenue, with hours restricted to 7:00 AM through 11:00 PM to comply with local ordinances regarding special permits for late-night operations.

items.title: School Building Maintenance Allocation
items.summary: Passed a resolution requiring that future school department budget submissions include a separate 5% allocation specifically designated for building maintenance and upkeep.

items.title: Medford High School Fire Detail Costs
items.summary: Requested a breakdown of man-hours and costs for stationing a firefighter at Medford High School while the fire alarm system remains disconnected from the master box.

items.title: Commendation for Carol Rickenbacker
items.summary: Congratulated Carol Rickenbacker on her retirement from the Medford Public Schools following over 30 years of service.

items.title: Routine Resolutions and Ceremonials
items.summary: Approved routine matters including the announcement of Bicycle Safety Day, the Billy Falasca Scholarship deadline, a 70th wedding anniversary commendation, and funeral condolences.

items.title: Wright’s Pond Fee Structure
items.summary: Received public comment suggesting the implementation of discounted Wright’s Pond passes for families in financial need to mitigate recent price increases.

items.title: Tufts University Air Rights Project
items.summary: Requested minutes and an architectural presentation from Tufts University regarding a proposed air rights project near Boston Avenue.

items.title: Personnel Disclosure Dispute
items.summary: Discussed the status of a previously failed motion regarding the mandatory disclosure of new hires and promotions by department heads during budget hearings.
